content_sections.body: In this lesson, focus on present perfect for general experience and past simple with a finished time. Notice how the ideas about a science podcast are linked so that the listener can follow the speaker's meaning.
content_sections.title: Notice the language

content_sections.body: I have listened to the science podcast several times, so I know its usual format. Last night I heard an episode about sleep, and it changed one of my habits.
content_sections.title: Context and meaning

content_sections.body: Prepare a three-sentence response about a science podcast. Include the lesson language, one concrete detail, and a clear link between your ideas.
content_sections.title: Guided use

items: The speaker gives no view or experience.
The speaker reaches the opposite conclusion.
exercises.prompt: Choose the statement that best matches the message about a science podcast.
Complete this Media experiences sentence with a suitable linker: I have experience of this topic, ____ I can explain my view clearly.

Read the text: "I have listened to the science podcast several times, so I know its usual format. Last night I heard an episode about sleep, and it changed one of my habits." Then answer: Which episode did the speaker hear last night?
Give a connected response about a science podcast, then respond politely to one follow-up view.
exercises.rubric: States a clear experience or viewpoint.; Supports the main idea with a relevant detail.; Links ideas clearly and responds tactfully.

objectives: Relate media experiences and distinguish finished time from current relevance.

constraints: Keep transcript private until the first answer.
Ask exactly one question before revealing it.
Use no media; use only the supplied transcript.
listening.goal: Identify the main point and supporting detail about a science podcast.
listening.instruction: Listen once to a short message about a science podcast. Answer one question before seeing the transcript, then listen again for the linking language.

pronunciation.goal: Use sentence stress to make the main viewpoint about a science podcast clear.
pronunciation.instruction: Read the key message about a science podcast aloud. Stress the word that carries the main contrast or new information, first slowly and then naturally.

constraints: Use at most four tutor turns.
End after the learner has supported and clarified the main point.
speaking.goal: Complete a connected exchange about a science podcast.
speaking.instruction: Discuss a science podcast with the tutor. Give your experience or opinion, support it, and respond tactfully to one different view.

constraints: Do not replace the learner draft.
writing.goal: Write a supported B1 response about a science podcast.
writing.instruction: Write 5-6 connected sentences about a science podcast. Include a clear main point, a reason or example, and a tactful contrast. Submit your draft first.

title: Media experiences
